⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 10/10 — HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
I came to Amaya’s Grooming #1 on Cook Rd in Houston as a complete last-minute grooming emergency, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience!

I had the pleasure of meeting Angie, and she was AMAZING with all three of my fur babies. It can be really hard to find a groomer who takes last-minute or walk-in appointments, so even though it was a drive for me, I decided to give them a try and I can confidently say I do not regret it one bit!
My babies were treated so well, and you can genuinely tell that everyone there cares about the animals they work with. They came out looking SO clean, fluffy, and smelling amazing. I was so happy with how they turned out!

They also offer so many great services, including dog and cat grooming, fur dying, boarding, and a huge selection of pet supplies like leashes, bowls, accessories, and CLOTHES!

The clothing section had me wanting to take the whole store home with me LOL.

I’m so happy I found this place and will definitely be coming back. Thank you so much to Angie and everyone at Amaya's for taking such good care of my babies, especially on such short notice. It means so much to me!

Here are some pictures of my babies after their spa day. I WILL BE COMING BACK!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 10/10, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THEM!

I came to Amaya’s Grooming #1 on Cook Rd, Houston as a last minute emergency because I needed my babies groomed, and I honestly couldn't have found a better place.

I had the pleasure of meeting Angie, and she was AMAZING with my three babies. It's so hard to find a groomer who accepts last-minute appointments or even walk-ins, so even though it was a bit far, I decided to make the trip, and I don't regret it at all.

They treated my babies so well, and you can tell they truly love animals and care about them. They came out super clean, fluffy, and smelling delicious. I was so happy with the result.

They also have tons of services and products: grooming for dogs and cats, hair coloring, boarding, and a huge variety of things for our pets, like leashes, bowls, accessories, and even CLOTHES.

Honestly, I wanted to buy the whole store of clothes! 😂

I'm so glad I found this place, and I'm definitely going back. Thank you so much to Angie and the whole team at Amaya's for taking such good care of my babies, especially with such short notice. I truly appreciated it!

Here are some pictures of my babies after their spa day. I'LL DEFINITELY BE BACK! 🐾
I loved the service! They did a beautiful job with Lizzy 🐶💕 She came out looking gorgeous, clean, and happy. You can tell they really care and love the dogs. I'll definitely bring her back! ✨ …

We had such a wonderful experience with Amaya Grooming 🐶❤️ my baby came home looking absolutely beautiful, clean, and so well-groomed. The staff was friendly, caring, and did an amazing job taking care of her. We’re very happy with the service and will definitely be coming back. Thank you for taking such great care of our sweet Amaya! 🐾✨

In my opinion, this place is useless, and I will never take my dog ​​there again. I saw how they treated my dog, and it's not nice to see how badly they treated her. They grabbed her ears very roughly and pulled them back. If someone works in pet care, they should know how to treat an animal, especially a small one that isn't going to bite. And the cashier said they have to hold them like that. In my opinion, it's not the right way to treat them. If you don't have the vocation for that job, just don't do it. I saw myself how they pulled my dog's ears. I will never give these people another peso. I pay for a service, not to have my pet mistreated. So, I advise people that when you take your pets there, stay and watch the screen they have there that shows what they do to your pets. This happened on Saturday at store number 91, according to them, because in my opinion, that staff has no professionalism in what they do. 😡😡😡😡😡😡
Excellent service. I've been bringing my dog ​​for over three years and he always gets a great haircut. Very clean and excellent service.

I've been going to Amayas for years, and my dog ​​and I are thrilled with their service. The staff is very friendly and excellent, and they always make my dog ​​look gorgeous with his haircuts. They always return him in perfect condition. I wouldn't trade them for anyone. I encourage everyone to visit Amayas Grooming #1, highly recommended 10/10, and now they're painting my tail for free! 🥇
I love the attention and service; June is super happy when he visits Amayas Grooming Salon.
Excellent service, very loving with pets 🫶🏻 …
I been going to Amaya’s Grooming for about 5-6 years now and I’m always leaving happy with the service they provide. Love how Take care of my pet . I recommend them .
I love this place, I've been visiting for over 3 years. The staff is very friendly and professional. They have new color services for puppies. Here's a before and after picture of my dog, I loved it!

I took my dog to this place for the second time. Considering how much I paid, I expected them to at least provide good service, but the grooming was horrible.

I specifically told the gentleman that I wanted my dog’s head to be left fluffier and longer than the rest of his body, but he did the exact opposite. They did not shave his private areas or clean his anal area. I also paid for teeth cleaning, and that was not done either.

His nails were cut but not filed, and they actually looked worse afterward.

Overall, my experience was horrible. I would not recommend this place. I can’t speak for their other locations, but at Location #1, they practically did the same thing I could have done myself at home.
My experience was excellent. I was attended to by a young woman named Angie and her colleague on duty, whose name I'm sorry I didn't ask, but personally they treated my baby like a king and the other
Thank you Elsy, you did an excellent job. Thank you so much Amaya's #1, not even PetSmart does this excellent work for me.

The service was absolutely fantastic, they were so kind and my dog ​​felt like family. They were so welcoming and their work was incredibly professional. I've finally found a place I can take her and love so much! 10 out of 10, I highly recommend it!

I highly recommend Amaya's Grooming on Cook Rd. I've been coming there for many years. They take excellent care of my Chanel. Miss Angy, Elsy, and Zaira were all very kind to my girl. I truly recommend Amaya's Grooming.
I always take my dog ​​and today I'm taking another one; I like the service.
I take all my dogs there; they treat them with love and make them look beautiful. I like the staff's service. The manager is an excellent person, and the owner is very kind. Highly recommended.

THE WORST PLACE EVER. I took my 7 month old golden doodle and he came back traumatized with anxiety. I lifted my hand to give him a treat (like I always do) and he flinches thinking I’m going to hit him.Ear infections. His nails were cut but not trimmed. The staff is rude , I can only imagine the attitudes of the groomers towards the pets.
Thank you for your great work.

I had already visited several places to groom my dog ​​Kiara and hadn't been lucky enough to find a place where they took good care of her, but one day on Instagram I came across one of your posts and I have to tell you, last March 5th I took my baby there and you have no idea how I felt seeing my beautiful dog because you took such good care of her. Thank you for your service. I'm sorry I didn't ask the name of the girl who took care of her, but thank you for your work.

Excellent place, I used it for 6 years until my pet passed away from old age… The love and dedication with which they treat the animals is unique; when a pet isn't used to being bathed and having its hair cut, it makes their job difficult, but they have all the patience in the world.

It's a terrible, awful place; they abuse animals. I took my dog ​​there, and they had her soaking wet, drying herself with a fan. She was shivering from the cold, and they didn't care. That's animal abuse. Don't take your dogs to that place. And when I complained to the receptionist, she was incredibly rude. Don't take your pets there!
I love how they treat my beautiful little ones 💖 💕

This was a terrible job, I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. It was ridiculously expensive and they ruined my dog ​​🤦🏼‍♂️😔😪😔😔😔😔😔😔 They only accept cash and they destroyed my dog. They cut off all the fur under one eye, it was so messy, it didn't even look like they'd bathed her, and they charged me $55. I'll never go back.

I took my dog ​​🐕 for his first grooming. He turned out okay, not like the reference photo they have there, but he looked good. However, I noticed they hurt my dog ​​around his genitals and belly. As a first-time customer, they should have been more careful and attentive in their services. …

I took my dog ​​in for a haircut and everything, but they were heartless savages doing a terrible job. The other people there weren't there; they're new. They went too far with my dog; they almost poked out his eye. I called, and they told me to bring him in, and the woman told me the dog had an infection, like she was a doctor. The man countered by saying it was just eye discharge stuck to his eyes. If the savages who did that were professionals, they should have called me and told me they weren't going to touch that area, but they were silent. My son looked for him and didn't notice. If I had seen them there right then, I would have called the police. And the nails were badly cut, and the haircut was awful. They were cruel to my dog, who is my life 😭 I'm taking him to the clinic today.
Now that I have to ask Trump about the price increase, what a nice response! When I trusted him last time, I got him a bad haircut and they always leave his hair red. I'll never go back.

This is my dog’s ear for the SECOND time. I told them before they even started NOT to clean his ears bc whatever product they used the first time gave him such a bad infection within 6 hours of leaving the salon that he got put on ear ointment and antibiotics for TWO WEEKS. I went back because they’re close to my house, and I liked the cut and didn’t need an appointment, but literally I told this lady-the OWNER, and she kept ignoring me and cutting me off, and showing me how her products were all animal safe, and I said ma’am I’m not trying to offend you or say your products are bad, but my dog is severely allergic to the ear cleaner you add on him & when I came to pick him up-behold they CLEANED his EARS with the SAME PRODUCT AGAIN. AGAINST my PERMISSION. I called complained and they said they would check the camera supposedly, like how does that help? If I left and immediately PUS was coming out his ear, and my dog has regular visits he was not sick prior to this nor did he have an ear infection. She never called me back didn’t even apologize or offer me a refund I mean literally this woman did not care. I suggest you are careful bc small mistakes like this where they don’t even make sure they are annotating allergies or recording the correct dog to the owner can cause life threatening consequences. If she can’t even call to apologize that shows the amount of care she truly has for your pets. Be careful just pay for someone else.
Great service! Lola was very happy!
They treat Leo wonderful and have accommodated to my pets needs. Phenomenal job! I take him to #3 and #1
The service was excellent, and my dogs came out looking beautiful.

Hmmmm . Where to start , my dog  came her last year and had a bad cut on her belly , when I confronted the owner no
one could give me an explanation as to why . This place is a scam also ! They tell you one price and charge you another price ! The owner is a liar . Save your money and go where they treat your animals with respect .

I am absolutely heartbroken and in disbelief after my experience at this grooming shop. When I came to pick up my dog, I walked in to find her being treated in a way that no animal should ever have to endure. As a pet owner, I trust groomers to provide care, patience, and kindness — instead, what I witnessed was abusive and completely unacceptable.

No one should ever have to question if their pet is safe in the hands of a groomer, yet that is exactly how I feel now. My dog deserves love and gentle handling, not mistreatment. I will never bring her back here and strongly urge other pet parents to reconsider before trusting this place with their beloved animals.

Our pets cannot speak for themselves — it’s up to us to protect them. What I saw was wrong, and I cannot stay silent about it.

Horrible place !!!!!

Great service always welcoming ..
Amazing job
My sweet boy Whiskey always looks handsome and smells lovely after his grooming with them ..
This place has gotten super expensive. They charge 100 dollars for small dogs. I always ask for short cut all around no special cut.

I'm a frequent customer of this place, well, I used to be, because starting today I won't be taking my children there again. In the past, the service was excellent, but today there was a different staff. I took my two children in for haircuts and everything they needed. I explained to the person at the front that I wanted a summer cut, but not too short (their hair wasn't knotted). When I went to pick them up, they were completely bald, and the hair was badly cut, super short. They didn't even file their nails. I asked them to clean the hair out of their ears, and they said they wouldn't let me. That's a lie! They are very well-behaved; I've never had any problems before. These new people did whatever they wanted. Completely terrible service. Thank God I only took two of my four children. It's true that hair grows back, but you pay for it, and I can expect good things. The man who attended to them didn't even let you explain; he just rushed them into the salon.
And to make matters worse, when I pick them up they are always happy and playful, but today I left them dejected and sad. I don't know... Something must have happened, and her eyes were full of tears. You have to think carefully about where you take your pets. This happens because they don't have qualified staff.
Thank you for your patience with Marie Pie

Best in town!

The care given to pets is excellent, caring and kind
